title: Authoritative phase-delivery loop ownership map
audit_scope: Static source, tests, migrations, and documentation only; no provider calls.

excluded.reason: Registered-workspace work is explicitly outside this reconciliation. Canonical Stacks identities are used instead.

transitions.name: accept exact human input
transitions.persistence_owner: A Funes-backed host adapter implementing Elwin UserInputStore; Elwin owns acceptance semantics.
transitions.authorization_check: Submitting HumanActorReference is distinct from semantic author; delegated authorship requires an attestation reference.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: SendPrimaryAskInput deduplicates channel + submitting actor + client submission ID and rejects conflicting replay.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Immutable byte-preserving PrimaryAskUserInput and ordered attachment references.

transitions.name: interpret input as intent
transitions.persistence_owner: Funes adapter for durable history; Elwin owns Intent identity, family, version, status, and supersession.
transitions.authorization_check: Human edits must carry the editing actor/provenance at the application boundary; Elwin has no actor authorization service.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Interpretation versions are immutable siblings/successors; supersededBy requires the next version in the same family and source input.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Intent provenance, uncertainty, constraints, origin, and replacement lineage.
transitions.unresolved_gap: No published Elwin persistence port for Intent/Conversation; the Funes adapter contract is described but not typed.

transitions.name: deliberate and hand off
produced_object_or_event: Versioned Elwin Conversation with a handoff reference
transitions.persistence_owner: Funes adapter for historical versions; Elwin owns current conversation transitions.
transitions.authorization_check: Only an active conversation accepts messages, intents, events, or finish; application policy authorizes the actor.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Optimistic version is explicit, but duplicate event/handoff identity enforcement is not implemented.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Input/intent references, source message observations, events, status, version, and portable handoff.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Elwin has no typed Decision Request or execution-readiness handoff object; handoffs are generic CrossPackageReference values.

transitions.name: promote a possibility into planning work
produced_object_or_event: Titan-owned work reference retained by Elwin Twinkle
transitions.persistence_owner: Host stores Titan work and Elwin version independently; neither package mutates the other aggregate.
transitions.authorization_check: PromotionRequest records actor/provenance, but host policy authorizes promotion.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: TwinklePromoter makes exact idempotency-key replay stable and rejects conflicting reuse.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Exact Twinkle ID/version, provenance, selected context, concepts, and promoted work reference.

transitions.name: author and version a phase plan
produced_object_or_event: Titan Plan with ordered PlanStep values and immutable replacement lineage
transitions.persistence_owner: Host adapter; Titan has no Plan store port.
transitions.authorization_check: No package authorization check; plan authorship and replacement authority are host policy.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Stable Plan/PlanStep IDs and replacementPlanId preserve versions; no compare-and-swap API is published.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Conversation origin, step outcome, disposition, acceptance criteria, plan status, and replacement ID.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Durable Plan persistence/version authority is untyped.

transitions.name: compile planning records into a work kit
transitions.persistence_owner: Host adapter persists immutable WorkKit versions; Titan owns validation and status.
transitions.authorization_check: PlanningRecords transitions validate legal option/checkpoint state; actor authorization remains host policy.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Compilation identity and supersedes lineage distinguish exact work; assembled work cannot be presented as executable.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Outcome, first action, dependencies, scope fence, capability IDs, verification/completion/failure criteria, source provenance.

transitions.name: compile and evaluate the planned-task graph
transitions.persistence_owner: Host stores graph bytes and implements durable PlannedTaskGraphVersionAuthority.
transitions.authorization_check: RequiredApproval values and active PlanningInterrupt values gate readiness; they do not grant Logres dispatch authority.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Graph IDs/version authority prevent stale handoff; dependency order, cycle checks, and supersession are deterministic.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Dependency graph, approvals, inputs, scope, capability IDs, template ID, criteria, readiness reasons, and completion proof.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Quain declares compatibility but does not execute it; OrbisTemplateId points to a package with no implementation.

transitions.name: emit dispatchable planning work
transitions.persistence_owner: Handoff is a deterministic projection; owner records remain in Titan storage.
transitions.authorization_check: Only dependency-complete, approval-complete, capability-compatible, input-ready, non-interrupted tasks on the active graph are emitted.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Rebuilding from the same active graph is deterministic; superseded graph references fail closed.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Graph/work-kit lineage and the complete ready-task contract.
transitions.unresolved_gap: No typed adapter maps PlannedTaskHandoff into Logres requests/tasks.

transitions.name: materialize execution requests
transitions.owning_package: Logres for ExecutionRequest; Titan for PlanMaterialization
transitions.persistence_owner: Host implements Logres ExecutionRequestStore and stores Titan PlanMaterialization.
transitions.authorization_check: ExecutionRequest authorization context is explicit; SubmitExecutionRequest validates before persistence.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Caller supplies immutable request ID; corrections/children create new IDs; acceptance follows successful store return.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Original prompt, desired result, context, attachments, constraints, permissions, authorization, channel, lineage, deliberation origin.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Field mapping from Titan task contract to Logres ExecutionRequest is not published.

transitions.name: create executable task plan
transitions.persistence_owner: Host implements Logres TaskPlanStore.
transitions.authorization_check: Starting requires package readiness plus TaskStartAuthority; host supplies manual/automatic authority.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Stable TaskPlan/Task IDs; re-plan creates linked plan; package computes readiness/actions.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Objective, expected output, acceptance evidence, dependencies, readiness conditions, concurrency, human-input flag, target and agent labels.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Using DeterministicTaskPlanner after Titan decomposition would create a second plan. Titan-origin requests require a one-to-one DirectTaskPlanner adapter.

transitions.name: compile the immutable execution prompt
transitions.persistence_owner: Host implements Logres TaskPromptStore.
transitions.authorization_check: Allowed operations and permissions are frozen inputs; credential and source authorization happen before compilation.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Same input/compiler hash returns the existing version; changed declared input creates linked immutable version.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Canonical prompt bytes, compiler version, input hash, provenance hash, source manifests, permissions, result/reporting contracts.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Orbis has no manifest/template/context-input contracts to resolve into TaskPrompt inputs.

transitions.name: resolve canonical workspace and revision provenance
transitions.persistence_owner: Stacks SqliteWorkspaceRegistry owns registry persistence; Logres stores the immutable execution snapshot through its host adapters.
transitions.authorization_check: Stacks reports identity/availability; it does not grant execution. Logres WorkspaceAuthority and dispatch policy check the snapshot.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Canonical path/remote normalization and reconcile status make repeat discovery deterministic.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Workspace ID, repository ID, remote, checkout ID/kind, path, branch, HEAD/starting revision, clone URL, capture time.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Stacks has no distinct worktree or revision identity value; these are checkout observation fields. The local dep-logres stacks-contract copy must stay aligned with published Stacks.

transitions.name: resolve capability and compatibility facts
produced_object_or_event: Ordered capability manifests and explicit compatibility query result
transitions.persistence_owner: Quain reads canonical manifests; consumer stores selected immutable IDs/versions.
transitions.authorization_check: Concept resolution can report unauthorized; capability catalogue compatibility itself is read-only and not execution authority.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Manifest ID/version/contractVersion and deterministic dependency ordering bound replay.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Ports, dependencies, readiness, parallelism, approvals, compatibility constraints, exit criteria, vocabulary.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Compatibility is declared/read, not evaluated against a complete agent/runtime/target candidate; dep-quain is an empty placeholder while sifrious/quain is active.

transitions.name: select a concrete execution target
transitions.persistence_owner: Host supplies inventory and implements ExecutionTargetStore; provider facts remain provider-owned observations.
transitions.authorization_check: Every candidate and manual override passes repository, workspace, class, capability, health, freshness, workload, and explicit authorization checks.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Deterministic sorted candidates; automatic selection succeeds only when exactly one eligible target remains.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Requirements snapshot, candidate evaluations/rejections, selected target, alternatives, reason, observed/selected times.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Provider recommendation and concrete target resolution are not separate typed projections yet; agentAdapter is legacy compatibility metadata.

transitions.name: approve and authorize dispatch
transitions.persistence_owner: Host grant authority persists grants; RunStore persists the approved snapshot.
transitions.authorization_check: Actor, target, repository, workspace/path containment, environment, runtime, permissions, validity, and observation freshness must all match.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Equivalent approved context is stable; changed/stale context requires a new policy decision before invocation.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Explicit allowed/denied decision and complete approved authority snapshot.
transitions.unresolved_gap: The host authority that issues/revokes grants remains application policy.

transitions.name: create run, attempt, and bounded lease
transitions.persistence_owner: Host implements RunStore and ExecutionStateStore with atomic uniqueness/compare-and-swap.
transitions.authorization_check: Only the current Attempt and active Lease token grant lifecycle mutation authority.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Stable local Run precedes network I/O; acquisition/renewal/release operation IDs are replay-safe; retries create linked Attempts.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Immutable run provenance plus complete attempt/lease lineage and versioned current state.

transitions.name: reserve provider invocation, dispatch, bind acknowledgement, or reconcile
transitions.owning_package: Logres for policy and identity; host provider adapter for transport
produced_object_or_event: Run awaiting acknowledgement, acknowledged, dispatch-failed, or reconciliation-required
transitions.persistence_owner: Host implements ProviderInvocationPersistence and RunStore with atomic reservation/status transitions and unique provider identity.
transitions.authorization_check: The Run must carry a frozen DispatchAuthorizationSnapshot matching invocation provenance before reservation or dispatch.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Invocation ID and idempotency key reserve once; a reserved replay resumes, a dispatching replay becomes acknowledgement-uncertain without redispatch, exact acknowledgement is duplicate-safe, and lookup reconciles the same Run.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Invocation reservation/status lineage, dispatch outcome, stable provider execution binding, lookup status, timestamps, and failure reason.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Provider SDK/authentication and factual lookup remain host adapters; Logres contains no live provider client.

transitions.name: deliver and accept an execution envelope
transitions.persistence_owner: RunnerLocalStateStore persists received/accepted/invoking/reporting/terminal stages before runtime invocation.
transitions.authorization_check: Authenticity, expiry, target, grant, workspace/repository observation, runtime, capabilities, active Run/Attempt/Lease are checked.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Envelope idempotency identity plus Run/Attempt/Lease reservation prevents duplicate runtime invocation across restart.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Runner acceptance/rejection and sequenced local runner events.

transitions.name: poll for outbound work and acknowledge the offered lease
transitions.owning_package: Logres for poll/ack contracts and lease policy; host for authenticated transport
produced_object_or_event: Logres RunnerPollResponse with lease or no-work
transitions.persistence_owner: ExecutionStateStore owns the offered Lease; host transport persists no competing queue lifecycle.
transitions.authorization_check: Runner identity and compatibility must match the offered envelope/target; lease acknowledgement must match Run, Attempt, Lease, and runner.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: No-work supplies a bounded retry delay; acknowledgement identity is deterministically hashed from Run + Attempt + Lease and exact replay converges.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Poll identity, offered envelope/lease, no-work reason/retry delay, and acknowledgement status.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Authenticated HTTP polling and the application proof that concurrent polls yield one Lease remain host integration work.

transitions.name: invoke the selected runtime adapter
transitions.persistence_owner: Wardrobe has no persistence; Logres runner/provider ports and Funes history persist normalized consequences.
transitions.authorization_check: Host allowlists adapter after Logres authorization; Wardrobe performs no authentication or lifecycle policy.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Wardrobe does not retry. ProviderRuntimeAdapter must acknowledge stable provider execution ID before output/outcome; Logres owns binding/reconciliation.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Output chunks, provider acknowledgement, status/exit/reason, and artifact metadata passed unchanged.
transitions.unresolved_gap: RuntimeInvocation carries a workspace path rather than canonical Stacks identity; Logres RuntimeRequest must remain the authoritative wrapper.

transitions.name: retain, report, and reconcile the runner terminal result
produced_object_or_event: runner local reporting or terminal stage
transitions.persistence_owner: RunnerLocalStateStore saves the terminal result before network delivery; host sink persists the corresponding canonical execution consequence.
transitions.authorization_check: Terminal delivery is correlated to the immutable Run, Attempt, and Lease accepted by the runner.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Lost receipt leaves local state at reporting; RunnerTerminalReconciler redelivers the retained result without invoking Wardrobe again; accepted/duplicate receipt converges to terminal.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Retained terminal status, result payload, delivery receipt, and local reporting/terminal stage.

transitions.name: normalize execution events and append history
transitions.owning_package: Logres for live execution semantics; Funes for durable history
transitions.persistence_owner: Logres host implements event storage; Funes SQL stores own append-only observations/history.
transitions.authorization_check: Logres checks run/task/attempt/invocation/provider association; Funes HistoricalAppendAuthorization checks tenant/scope append authority.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Event IDs deduplicate at-least-once delivery; Funes identity/append conflicts reject changed replay.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Original provider envelope, normalized event taxonomy, sequence gaps/reordering, typed references, provenance, and historical records.
transitions.unresolved_gap: The Logres-to-Funes projection adapter is not published.

transitions.name: verify, finalize, and retain terminal result
transitions.owning_package: Logres for verification/current result; Funes for historical evidence
transitions.persistence_owner: Host implements RunResultStore/ExecutionStateStore and RunResultHistorian; Funes retains evidence even if projection rebuilds.
transitions.authorization_check: Active lease gates terminal mutation; required verification is independent from runtime status and finalization policy.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Terminal replay with identical attempt/token/status/result is stable; terminal Run cannot reopen; historian failure remains explicit.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Check results and evidence references, pre/postflight records, local result, terminal reference, finalization status.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Human review and acceptance against exact evidence/revision are not package contracts.

transitions.name: recover, retry, reconcile, cancel, or time out
transitions.persistence_owner: ExecutionStateStore owns durable current state; Funes may retain historical observations.
transitions.authorization_check: Lease token authorizes attempt recovery; CancellationAuthorization authorizes cancellation intent.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Recovery/cancellation operation IDs reject conflicting reuse; uncertain acknowledgement reconciles the same attempt; retries create a linked attempt.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Failure class/reason/action, retry lineage, cancellation actor/reason/status, partial result reference.

transitions.name: review, accept, and merge exact work
transitions.owning_package: Burdgeon application policy; Stacks reads repository/provider facts
produced_object_or_event: Explicit human acceptance/rejection and merge/finalization observation
transitions.persistence_owner: Funes should retain the decision/history; canonical Git provider owns merge; Burdgeon projects the decision.
transitions.authorization_check: Human reviewer and repository merge authority must be checked by the host/provider adapter.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Acceptance must bind exact Run, Attempt, evidence set, and revision; merge replay must use provider identity.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Reviewer decision, exact revision/evidence references, provider merge observation.
transitions.unresolved_gap: No typed acceptance decision, review result, merge command, or final revision relation exists across the audited packages.

transitions.name: observe post-merge application state
transitions.owning_package: Bindle for inspection/capture; Funes for durable observation
produced_object_or_event: Bindle InspectionSnapshot, scan records, captures, RenderEvidence
transitions.persistence_owner: Bindle DatabaseManager/models own scan/capture state; Funes owns cross-run historical evidence.
transitions.authorization_check: Bindle local-only middleware/driver policy protects capture; workspace/revision authority must be supplied by host.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Inspection is snapshot-based; scan Runs are distinct. No canonical desired-vs-observed comparison identity exists.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Revision-tagged structure snapshot, route/component scans, HTML/screenshot captures, render evidence, explicit unavailable/stale states.
transitions.unresolved_gap: Bindle does not implement the epic's desired-state artifact, observation, or Difference contracts; it cannot yet close the deterministic comparison loop.

transitions.name: synchronize knowledge and choose the next candidate
transitions.owning_package: Funes for new evidence; Titan for planning candidates; Burdgeon for composition
produced_object_or_event: New historical observations and a rebuilt Titan candidate/readiness projection
transitions.persistence_owner: Funes retains evidence; Titan host persistence retains planning records; Burdgeon caches only rebuildable projections.
transitions.authorization_check: Read access is package/tenant policy; selecting or dispatching the next candidate still requires explicit planning and dispatch approval.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Funes append identity and Titan graph/version authority prevent duplicate history or stale handoff.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Post-merge facts, provenance/freshness, readiness reasons, next-candidate references.
transitions.unresolved_gap: No cross-package synchronization application service or deterministic next-candidate projection is implemented.

transitions.name: project work into Linear
transitions.owning_package: Burdgeon adapter; Linear remains a non-canonical projection
produced_object_or_event: Linear issue fields, relations, comments, and links
transitions.persistence_owner: Linear owns its projection; package aggregates remain canonical.
transitions.authorization_check: Host checks Linear credentials/scope; package status never derives from ticket status.
transitions.retry_or_idempotency_boundary: Adapter must key by canonical owner reference and treat provider issue/comment IDs only as projection identities.
transitions.evidence_emitted: Projection timestamps, source references, and links back to canonical evidence.
transitions.unresolved_gap: No audited Linear projection adapter or mapping contract exists.

PhasePacket.decision: Do not add a Logres domain object or lifecycle. Add a future immutable Titan read projection only after the missing source contracts exist.
PhasePacket.persistence: Rebuildable host cache only; canonical fields remain with their owners.

fields.name: concepts
fields.owner: Organon intended; Quain currently implements identity
fields.gap: No Organon package/contract was discoverable; ownership differs from current implementation.

fields.name: current_and_desired_state
fields.gap: Desired-state artifact and Difference contracts are absent.

fields.name: manual_copy_paste_rendering
fields.gap: No portable rendering contract; it must consume the projection without becoming canonical.

ExecutionPacket.decision: Do not add a second execution aggregate. Add a future immutable Titan execution-candidate projection whose fields are owner references/snapshots and which compiles into existing Logres objects.
ExecutionPacket.persistence: Rebuildable host cache; persisted owner objects and immutable Logres snapshots are authoritative.

fields.name: workspace_repository_checkout_revision
fields.gap: Separate worktree/revision value objects are absent.

fields.name: provider_recommendation
fields.owner: Titan candidate projection; Wardrobe describes available adapters
fields.gap: Provider recommendation is not a typed contract.

decisions.reason: It is a Titan-owned read projection, not a new aggregate; required Organon/Bindle/Orbis inputs are missing.
It is a Titan-owned execution-candidate projection compiling into Logres, not a second execution lifecycle.
Use Titan PlanStatus, PlanStepDisposition, WorkKitStatus, PlannedTaskGraphStatus, and PlannedTaskReadiness.
Use Logres TaskStatus, RunStatus, AttemptStatus, lease, cancellation, verification, and finalization contracts.
Orbis must define portable agent manifests/roles; labels in Logres TranslatedTask are not definitions.
Keep provider recommendation separate from Logres concrete target selection and Wardrobe runtime adapter invocation.
Titan PlanMaterialization already records zero/one/many CrossPackageReference values.
PromotionRequest and CrossPackageReference preserve source version/provenance.
Use Logres EvidenceReference/Event identities and Funes Observation/HistoricalAppend; do not copy evidence into packet state.
Ticket state cannot drive Titan readiness, Logres lifecycle, review, or acceptance.
MME-677 is outside scope; use canonical Stacks workspace/repository/checkout/revision evidence.
